DISTRICT DISASTER MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY (DDMA)
OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT MAGISTRATE & COLLECTOR, CENTRAL REVENUE DISTRICT
Civil Lines, Collectorate Campus

ORDER NO: DM/DMA/2026/REL-77
DATE OF ISSUE: 19 October 2026

SUBJECT: Operationalization of Flood Relief and Ration Distribution Camps

In exercise of the powers conferred under Section 30 of the Disaster Management Act, 2005, the following directives are hereby enforced across all riverbank revenue circles:

1. RELIEF CAMP OPERATIONS:
- Community relief shelters and grain distribution centers will function from 20 October 2026 to 05 November 2026.
- Operational daily timings: 08:00 AM to 06:00 PM IST.
- Direct Emergency Assistance Helpline: 1077 (Toll Free).

2. ENTITLEMENTS & RATION PROVISION:
- Affected families residing in inundated wards are entitled to 10kg wheat flour, 5kg rice, 1kg pulses, and clean drinking water pouches per adult member.
- All rations and medical aid distributed at district camps are 100% FREE OF CHARGE. No fee or token charge shall be collected.
